_comment: Registry of case specifications consumed by scripts/eval.py. Static checks are not behavioral evidence.
owners are context skills, not proof of runtime routing; canonical decisions remain in .agents/skills.
case_count and format are mandatory; every case source is registered exactly once.
review paths identify existing review records but their existence does not mark cases passed.
live_exclusions preserve historical criteria incompatible with current coverage; every exclusion has a reason.
